Pearl — Dental & Cosmetic Dentistry Website Template

Pearl is a clean, reassuring website template for dental clinics and cosmetic dentists, built on Bootstrap 5 with vanilla JavaScript and no jQuery. It includes a conversion-focused homepage with an inline appointment form and a detailed treatments-and-booking page, featuring a working before/after smile slider, count-up trust badges, a testimonials slider, transparent pricing, an insurance strip, and an accessible FAQ. The design uses a fresh teal-and-coral palette with softly rounded cards and generous whitespace, and every color lives in CSS custom properties for quick theming. Pearl is free for personal and commercial use. Bootstrap 5 and Google Fonts (Baloo 2 + Mulish) are self-hosted or loaded via the standard font CDN; simply open index.html to preview, and connect the forms to your booking system to go live.
